description: ADP: Android DevTools Protocol (docs/04-adp.md). CDP-style domains, commands, events, types. The version is contracts/adp/VERSION. Only shapes the docs and owner decisions fully define are listed. 64-bit integers are JSON decimal strings: type string with format int64 or uint64. 32-bit and smaller integers are JSON numbers: type integer, with format uint32 or int32 where the width is fixed. Type binary is a base64 string (RFC 4648 section 4, with padding), as in CDP. Extensions to the CDP structure: errors, envelope, scope on commands and events, targetTypes on commands, format, discriminator/variants on tagged unions, nullable on optional properties (explicit null clears the field). targetTypes lists the target types whose sessions accept the command; sent in the session of a target of another type: INVALID_REQUEST. A session-scoped command without targetTypes has no target type fixed yet.

errors.name: FRAME_EXPIRED
errors.description: The requested frameId is no longer in the ring buffer. No other frame is substituted.

errors.name: NOT_ACTIONABLE
errors.description: The action cannot be performed on the target.

errors.name: POLICY_DENIED
errors.description: Denied by policy, including an Authorizer denial at attach.

errors.name: UNAUTHENTICATED
errors.description: The credential is missing or invalid, or a message arrived before authentication.

errors.name: UNSUPPORTED_VERSION
errors.description: No protocol version both sides support.

errors.name: INVALID_REQUEST
errors.description: The envelope is malformed: not a Request object, an id that is not an integer in range or duplicates an in-flight request, a sessionId missing on a session-scoped or present on a connection-scoped method, a sessionId this connection does not hold, a command in the session of a target type it does not accept (targetTypes), or a message the connection state does not allow: a command before Connection.hello, a second Connection.hello, Connection.auth on an authenticated connection, a second App.uploadChunk in flight for one upload (before authentication: UNAUTHENTICATED).

errors.name: METHOD_NOT_FOUND
errors.description: The method names no command of this protocol version.

errors.name: INVALID_PARAMS
errors.description: The params do not follow the definition: a missing required value, a wrong type, an unknown enum value, an unknown union kind, a selector syntax error or unknown selector engine, an unknown diff format.

envelope.description: WebSocket text messages carry one JSON object each: Request (client to server), Response (server to client, one per Request), Event (server to client). Binary messages: see binary.

properties.name: id
properties.description: Non-negative integer, at most 2^53-1. Unique among the in-flight requests of the connection; otherwise INVALID_REQUEST.

properties.name: sessionId
properties.description: Absent for connection-scoped commands. Required for session-scoped commands. Otherwise INVALID_REQUEST.

properties.name: method
properties.description: Domain.command. Unknown: METHOD_NOT_FOUND.

properties.name: traceparent
properties.description: W3C Trace Context traceparent (https://www.w3.org/TR/trace-context/ section 3.2). Untrusted. A value that does not follow the format is ignored, as Trace Context requires; the request is not rejected for it. Whether the server continues the client's trace or starts a new trace linked to it is a server setting; default: a new trace with a link.

types.description: Exactly one of result and error is present.

properties.name: id
properties.description: The id of the Request.

properties.name: sessionId
properties.description: Present when the Request had one.

properties.name: method
properties.description: Domain.event.

properties.name: sessionId
properties.description: Absent for connection-scoped events.

properties.name: code
properties.description: One of errors[].name. Same code space as contracts/common ErrorCode.

envelope.binary: A binary WebSocket message starts with an 8-byte big-endian unsigned integer, the id of the Request it belongs to; the rest is the payload. From the server: sent before the Response with that id. From the client: exactly one after each App.uploadChunk Request, with that Request's id; the server answers that Request only after receiving it, also when it rejects the Request. A client binary message that follows no pending App.uploadChunk Request with its id, and an App.uploadChunk Request whose id duplicates an in-flight request, close the connection with status 1002 (RFC 6455 section 7.4.1). The client sends no other binary messages.

domains.description: Connection setup. Authentication: an Authorization: Bearer header (RFC 6750) on the WebSocket upgrade, or auth as the first message. Until authenticated, every other message is rejected with UNAUTHENTICATED. A token in the URL query string is not accepted. Both paths use the Authenticator SPI. Right after authentication, hello is required once before any other command. A connection is authenticated once; a new credential means a new connection.

commands.name: auth
commands.description: Authenticates the connection when the upgrade carried no Authorization header. On failure the server answers UNAUTHENTICATED and closes the connection. On an authenticated connection (by either path): INVALID_REQUEST; the connection keeps its credential.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Opaque token as issued, in RFC 6750 b64token syntax; the same string as in Authorization: Bearer.

commands.name: hello
commands.description: Version negotiation (docs/04-adp.md section 9). Required once per connection, right after authentication and before any other command; any other command before it, and a second hello, get INVALID_REQUEST. Compatible when the majors match, and for 0.x versions also the minors (semver caret rule); otherwise UNSUPPORTED_VERSION.

domains.description: CDP-style target model in flat session mode. Instances are top-level targets; display, window, process and webview targets sit beneath an instance. Attaching returns a sessionId; authorization is checked at attach.

types.description: Opaque session ID returned by attachToTarget.

properties.name: attached
properties.description: Whether this connection is attached to the target.

properties.name: parentId
properties.description: The target this one sits beneath. Absent for instance targets.

types.description: clientDetach: detachFromTarget on this session or on a session above it. targetGone: the session's target was destroyed (targetDestroyed is sent too). authorizationRevoked: the server ended the session because the Authorizer no longer allows it.

commands.name: getTargets
commands.description: Without a session: the instance targets. In a session: the targets beneath the session's target. Lists only targets the principal may attach to: a target the Authorizer denies, or for which it fails, is left out (fail closed).

commands.name: attachToTarget
commands.description: Attaches to a target. Instance targets: without a session. Other targets: in the session of the target they sit beneath. Denied by the Authorizer: POLICY_DENIED. Gone: TARGET_GONE.

commands.name: detachFromTarget
commands.description: Detaches sessionId, any session of this connection, and every session beneath it. Each detached session gets detachedFromTarget with reason clientDetach. Afterwards a message with a detached sessionId gets INVALID_REQUEST. A sessionId this connection does not hold: INVALID_PARAMS.

events.name: targetCreated
events.description: Same scoping and authorization filter as getTargets.

events.name: targetDestroyed
events.description: Same scoping and authorization filter as getTargets.

events.name: detachedFromTarget
events.description: The session sessionId ended. Sent without a session for a session attached without one, otherwise in the session it was attached in. Sessions beneath it end first, each with its own event and the same reason. No message carries the ended sessionId afterwards.

types.description: Opaque node ID. Stable for the node's lifetime and never reused.
The frame that trees, screenshots and events refer to.

properties.name: display
properties.description: Display number.

properties.name: vsyncId
properties.description: Choreographer vsync ID (app side). Decimal string.

properties.name: sfFrame
properties.description: SurfaceFlinger frame number (composition side). Decimal string.

types.description: Rectangle in display physical pixels, screen coordinates.
A node of the unified tree.

properties.name: bounds
properties.description: Screen pixels.

properties.name: actions
properties.description: Actions that can be performed.

properties.name: webviewTargetId
properties.description: CDP target reference when the node is a WebView.

types.description: Selector string. Grammar and semantics: contracts/adp/selectors/selector.ebnf. Conformance cases: contracts/adp/selectors/conformance.json. Syntax error or unknown engine: INVALID_PARAMS.
Tree diff format. nodeOps: TreeOp operations on node IDs. Extension point: a value the server does not know is rejected with INVALID_PARAMS.
Changed fields of a node. Absent: unchanged. null: the optional field is cleared. id and children never appear here; children change through insert, remove and move.
One nodeOps operation. Applied in array order; a parent is inserted before its children.

variants.description: Inserts node with its subtree under parentId, right after previousSiblingId, or as the first child when previousSiblingId is absent.
Removes the node with its subtree. Removed IDs are never reused.
Moves the node with its subtree under parentId, right after previousSiblingId, or as the first child when previousSiblingId is absent. The node keeps its ID.

commands.name: getTree
commands.description: Returns the unified tree for one frame.

events.name: treeMutated
events.description: The tree changed from baseFrameId to frameId (format nodeOps). A client whose current frame is not baseFrameId re-fetches with getTree; ops are never applied to another base.

types.description: When an input command resolves. dispatched: once the input is dispatched (no frameId). frameCommitted: at the first frame committed after the input took effect. idle: when the UI is idle, or when idleTimeoutMs elapses first; the command succeeds either way and its result says which (idle). The idle criterion and the default timeout are server settings.

properties.name: id
properties.description: Pointer ID.

properties.name: x
properties.description: Display physical pixels, screen coordinates.

properties.name: y
properties.description: Display physical pixels, screen coordinates.

commands.name: click
commands.description: Clicks a node. Gone: NODE_GONE. Cannot act: NOT_ACTIONABLE.

parameters.name: idleTimeoutMs
parameters.description: For resolveOn idle. Default: a server setting.

returns.name: frameId
returns.description: Absent for resolveOn dispatched. Otherwise the latest committed frame when the command resolved.

returns.name: idle
returns.description: Present for resolveOn idle only: true when the UI reached idle, false when idleTimeoutMs elapsed first.

commands.name: longClick
commands.description: Long-clicks a node. Errors as for click.

parameters.name: idleTimeoutMs
parameters.description: For resolveOn idle. Default: a server setting.

returns.name: frameId
returns.description: Absent for resolveOn dispatched. Otherwise the latest committed frame when the command resolved.

returns.name: idle
returns.description: Present for resolveOn idle only: true when the UI reached idle, false when idleTimeoutMs elapsed first.

commands.name: dispatchTouch
commands.description: One touch event in the coordinates of the session's display.

parameters.name: idleTimeoutMs
parameters.description: For resolveOn idle. Default: a server setting.

returns.name: frameId
returns.description: Absent for resolveOn dispatched. Otherwise the latest committed frame when the command resolved.

returns.name: idle
returns.description: Present for resolveOn idle only: true when the UI reached idle, false when idleTimeoutMs elapsed first.

commands.name: insertText
commands.description: Inserts text at the current input focus.

parameters.name: idleTimeoutMs
parameters.description: For resolveOn idle. Default: a server setting.

returns.name: frameId
returns.description: Absent for resolveOn dispatched. Otherwise the latest committed frame when the command resolved.

returns.name: idle
returns.description: Present for resolveOn idle only: true when the UI reached idle, false when idleTimeoutMs elapsed first.

commands.name: dispatchKey
commands.description: One key event. Repeat count and meta state are not defined yet; they will be optional parameters.

parameters.name: keyCode
parameters.description: The name of an android.view.KeyEvent KEYCODE_* constant, for example KEYCODE_ENTER. A name the server's Android release does not define: INVALID_PARAMS.

parameters.name: idleTimeoutMs
parameters.description: For resolveOn idle. Default: a server setting.

returns.name: frameId
returns.description: Absent for resolveOn dispatched. Otherwise the latest committed frame when the command resolved.

returns.name: idle
returns.description: Present for resolveOn idle only: true when the UI reached idle, false when idleTimeoutMs elapsed first.

commands.name: captureScreenshot
commands.description: Captures exactly the requested frame of the session's display, or FRAME_EXPIRED; no other frame is substituted.

parameters.name: frameId
parameters.description: Absent: the latest committed frame of the session's display. A frameId of another display: INVALID_PARAMS.

parameters.name: transfer
parameters.description: binary: the image is a binary message (envelope.binary). base64: the image is in data. Default: binary.

types.description: Opaque ID of an upload. An upload belongs to the connection and session that created it and is single-use: install consumes it. It is discarded when the connection closes, when its session ends, and after the upload idle-expiry setting passes without a command naming it.
Tagged union on kind. A server rejects a kind it does not know with INVALID_PARAMS.

variants.description: A finished upload of this session (finishUpload). Any other uploadId: INVALID_PARAMS. install consumes the upload whatever its result.

commands.name: createUpload
commands.description: Starts an upload of size bytes. size above the server's maximum upload size (a server setting), or 0: INVALID_PARAMS, before any bytes are sent.

returns.name: maxChunkSize
returns.description: The largest chunk payload in bytes uploadChunk accepts for this upload (the chunk-size server setting).

commands.name: uploadChunk
commands.description: Appends the payload of the client binary message that follows this Request (envelope.binary) to the upload. At most one uploadChunk per upload is in flight; a second: INVALID_REQUEST. A payload of 0 bytes or above maxChunkSize, one that would pass size, or an uploadId that names no unfinished upload of this session: INVALID_PARAMS, and nothing is appended.

commands.name: finishUpload
commands.description: Finishes the upload. Fewer bytes received than size: INVALID_PARAMS, and the upload stays unfinished. A digest that does not match the received bytes: INVALID_PARAMS, and the upload is discarded. sha256 not 64 lowercase hex digits, or an uploadId that names no unfinished upload of this session: INVALID_PARAMS.

parameters.name: sha256
parameters.description: SHA-256 (FIPS 180-4) of all size bytes, as 64 lowercase hex digits.
